FIELDS.NAME: Timber Supply Co.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Timber Supply Co., we operate as a wholesale distributor of quality building materials, focusing on new construction supplies. Our business primarily involves the procurement, warehousing, and distribution of products such as lumber, drywall, insulation, and metal framing. We have strategically positioned our facilities to ensure efficient inventory management and timely deliveries to contractors and construction companies in the region.

Our warehouses are equipped with automated inventory systems that maintain accurate stock levels and protect high-value items. We prioritize safety, adhering to robust fire prevention measures, including strategically placed fire extinguishers and regular safety audits. Our outdoor storage areas feature adequate fencing and lighting to deter theft and vandalism, while our delivery fleet is secured with protocols for safe transportation.

Timber Supply Co. is dedicated to compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations pertaining to the storage and transportation of building materials. Our commitment to risk management and ongoing safety improvements is reflected in our employee training programs and contingency plans for fire and theft incidents. Through these practices, we maintain a strong reputation for reliability and excellent service in the building materials supply industry.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Timber Hardware Supplies LLC, 5678 Timber Road, Springfield, IL 62701-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a fire incident caused by an electrical failure resulted in a loss of $2,500 in inventory damage, which has been fully documented and settled. Additionally, on July 20, 2023, a theft incident led to losses totaling $2,500 of tools and equipment, which are under review for potential recovery. Both cases are currently closed.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $5,000 deductible
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday 7:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM - 1:00 PM, Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Adequate fencing with controlled access and monitored surveillance systems around the outdoor storage areas to deter theft and vandalism.
